Connect your stock

Mwakete reads your sheet and shows changes before updating your store. How it works

Your connected stock

1. Where do you keep your stock now?

No system? Use Mwakete Inventory.

2. Link your Google Sheet

  1. Open your stock sheet and press Share.
  2. Add as Editor (so Mwakete can write sales back) or Viewer (read only).
  3. Copy the sheet's address from your browser and paste it here.

2. Choose your file and match the columns

Adding lots of new products? Fill one row per variety (same name = one product), save as CSV, choose it above and tick "Add items that aren't on Mwakete yet".

Which side is in charge?

Or leave this and match a Category column, so each row can have its own.

3. Check the changes

Nothing has changed yet.

Fix those rows in your file and import it again.
